messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] the model doesn't produce the output
parts:
you probably have a model where the posterior is almost flat.

make sure you use R-4.3 and the most recent testing version of INLA, if
you don't please retry and if that does not help, please share data/code
with he...@r-inla.org so I can check

H
